conversation.chooseBody: Messages go straight between your device and theirs.
conversation.noMessages: No messages yet. What you write stays on this device until {name}'s device takes it.
conversation.missing: This conversation is not on this device.
update.title: A new version is ready
update.body: Reload to use it. Nothing on this device changes.

sheet.add.yourCodeHelp: Read it out or show it to the person you are adding.
sheet.add.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it by hand.
sheet.add.needBoth: Enter their name and their code.
sheet.relay.title: Use my own relay server
sheet.relay.body: A relay server of your own gives your two devices a path when their networks will not connect directly. It only passes encrypted data along. You will set one up in settings, which this version does not have yet.
sheet.blocked.title: What this means
sheet.blocked.body1: Before anything is sent, both devices check that they are connected to each other and not to something in between.
sheet.blocked.body2: This time the check failed, so ParolNet closed the connection. Your waiting messages are still on this device. Networks that inspect traffic can cause this. Try again, or try from another network.
